notes.title: new func added `Batch processing of files containing the same part of filenames`
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600789/b29250d594a8ab56ef1669611ed4666b6c222205.png[/img]
Now for the app `Batch processing of files containing the same part of filenames`
Some new functions have been added.
1. If you drag a file in, it will show the file name in the textbox, because usually the `common part` is part of the file name, then you can easily type the `common part` by deleting a few words of the content in the textbox.
2. After you type the `common part` in that textbox, you can press Tab key on your keyboard to get the information about the whole files in that folder sharing the same `common part`, then you can copy them, or delete them, or cut them, or change the `common part` of them.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600789/e1425e3de782b92e05441aaa1372a4dd9f174067.png[/img]
1. Two new buttons have been added:
(1) Call the default program to open all the files in the folder.
(2) Call the default program to open all files in the folder containing the common part.
For example, when you want to open multiple mp4 files in that folder at the same time (your player has to support multi-opening) and watch them all together, you need this button. For another example, there are many doc files under this folder, each need to change part of the content, you can use this button to open them all, then change them one by one, save them one by one and close them one by one.

2. When you press the button `Change the common part to`, the input textbox of common part will be filled with the changed common part as well, so it will be easier for you to do next step to files with the new common part.
